description: Reusable Niri workspace layout recipes consumed by render-profile.sh when shared/wm/workspaces.json sets layout.niriRecipe or layout.niriRecipes.

tabbed.description: Tabbed column display for terminal-heavy workspaces.

balanced.description: Balanced primary column for coding or browser workspaces.

wide.description: Wide primary column with normal overflow centering.

single-focus.description: Single-column focus recipe for meetings, docs, and dashboards.
